name: TieredCache::get_or_compute

test_list.description: 16 concurrent callers for one key on a multi-thread runtime run the computation exactly once and all get its value.
If the computing caller is cancelled, a waiter takes over and computes; nobody hangs.
A failed computation is returned to its caller and not cached; the next call computes again.
After the TTL passes (fake clock), the value is computed again.
A value present only in L2 is returned without running the computation.
The returned future is Send (usable from tokio::spawn).

inputs.name: compute
inputs.description: Runs only on a miss in every tier.

output_description: The cached or freshly computed value.
